title: Mentors Set You Up For Development
text: the mentee must accept that the mentor is acting in the best interests of the mentee this is very important because the mentee has to believe that whatever the mentor recommends or instructs or advises is in the mentees best interest you may receive an instruction from your mentor that doesn't make sense at the moment or maybe even uncomfortable but what they are doing is in your best interest they know what you want to learn and so they will provide strange moments for you you've got to just believe what they say and carry out their instructions a mentor will never set you up for destruction they will set you up for development you
